items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I am in Central New York State and now I’m talking to someone in Cologne, Germany. Welcome Karolina Strassmayer.
Thank you, Monk. I appreciate it very much.
I’m going to introduce you as a saxophonist and a flute player and an educator and someone who got bit by jazz early on.
